purpose: A labelled set of user requests and the specialist that should take each, for measuring DELFIN's subagent_type routing. 'expected' is the preset name the request should reach, or null when no specialist fits and the generalist should do the work itself. Labelled by hand from the presets' own descriptions at origin/main 41fbf18e2; the label is the request's ideal routing, not what the product does today.
